_about: Strong scaling with the GPUlayer 0.8.0 Trainer (two-level gradient sync, ADR-0020) vs Lightning 2.6.6 under torchrun, 2026-11-01, on 8 AWS g4dn.xlarge (4 vCPU Xeon Platinum 8259CL each, one subnet, CPU training with gloo; the T4s unused). strong-scaling.log. Read by scripts/make_perf_charts.py.

strong_scaling.subtitle: A CNN on 32,768 images, 2 epochs; AWS g4dn.xlarge (4 vCPU), 4 processes per machine, gloo; same machines for both
strong_scaling.method: Wall time from start until the last process exits, median of 3 interleaved runs, both trainers on the same machines (GPUlayer pinned with worker_ids). GPUlayer uses two-level gradient sync (the default with gloo); Lightning its default DDP under torchrun.
